direct_evidence.body:
## Findings

Bikash checked the raw archive on 9/30, no ECOM files exist for 8/28 through 9/17. Those files were never received, not a backlog waiting to be reloaded. Peyman noted the same day that a missing blob folder means no file landed, and that a file's timestamp reflects when it lands, not the transaction date inside it.

| Source | Date range |
|---|---|
| Peyman's ask to Bikash, 9/28 | 8/28 to 9/10 |
| Bikash's archive check, 9/30 | 8/28 to 9/17, nothing found |
| Peyman's resend suggestion, 9/30 | 8/28 to 9/15 |

direct_evidence.body:
## Texto listo para pegar (ingles, DM Teams a Peyman)

Hi Peyman, going point by point.

**Root cause.** Confirmed, it was the connector on our side, not Nike. Saddam fixed it around 9/15, current days have been flowing fine since.

**What I need from Bikash or Delivery.** Confirm everything after 9/17 loaded clean, and reach out to Nike to request a resend for 8/28 through 9/17.

**Have they sent all the backlog files.** No. Bikash checked the raw archive directly and found nothing for 8/28 to 9/17, wider than the 8/28 to 9/10 you asked him to reload. Those files were never received, nothing to reload on our end, Nike has to send them.

**How we identify backlog files.** Check the archive path directly against the expected daily files for the range, missing dates mean never received. That is how Bikash found this gap.

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-30-rcs-28756-respuesta-brian
direct_evidence.body:
Hello Brian,

Thank you for your patience while we worked through this, and for all the details you and your team provided along the way.

I want to give you an update on where things stand. The underlying issue affecting new ECOM order data has been resolved, and days since September 19 have been processing normally on our side.

While reviewing the earlier window, I found that our records show no ECOM order files received from your systems for the period of August 28 through September 17. I want to confirm we have everything for that window.

Whenever your team has a moment, could you resend your ECOM order files covering August 28 through September 17? Once they arrive, our system will pick them up and process them automatically, the same way it does for any other day.

I will keep you posted here as soon as I have an update on that resend. Please let me know if anything on the dates above does not match what you show on your side.

Thank you again, Brian.
